title: Product expectation by conditioning on the last coordinate
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $n$ be a natural number, let $p_0,\ldots,p_n$ be probability mass functions on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega^{n+1}\to\mathbb{R}$. The expectation of $f$ under the independent product distribution equals the expectation over the last coordinate of the conditional expectation over the first $n$ coordinates: $\mathbb{E}[f]=\mathbb{E}_{a\sim p_n}\bigl[\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\bigotimes_{j=0}^{n-1}p_j}f(x_0,\ldots,x_{n-1},a)\bigr]$.
